description: This file defines the Tracker class for SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, including methods for retrieving recent views, making items invisible, and logging page views. It manages tracker data and user navigation history.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: A class representing tracker entries, extending SugarBean, with methods for retrieving recent items, hiding items, and logging page views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tracker object, loading vardefs if necessary.

methods.name: get_recently_viewed
methods.description: Returns the most recently viewed items for a user, optionally filtered by modules.

methods.name: makeInvisibleForAll
methods.description: Sets a tracker item as invisible for all users.

methods.name: logPage
methods.description: Logs the time spent on a page for analytics.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Overrides to support ACL roles, returns false.
